description: For a traveller who booked with Vuelo before, in another conversation, and wants to see, change, cancel or get help with it: Vuelo texts the booking's own page to the mobile on that booking. On that page they can cancel, add it to their calendar, and contact Vuelo's team. Pass their Vuelo booking reference (VU-...) and the email or mobile they booked with. If they do not have the reference, pass the mobile they booked with alone (with country if it is not written with +): Vuelo texts that number a link to each of its latest bookings. You never see a link or whether anything matched, so tell them: if the details match, Vuelo has texted the mobile on the booking. They can also see every booking on their mobile at Vuelo's bookings page (/bookings on the site their booking links open), with a code texted to it. Never search their email or messages for a reference instead: ask for the mobile. For anything else they want a person for, use contact_support.

country.description: For a mobile typed the local way (06 12 34 56 78), the country it is from, as an ISO code (FR). Not needed for a number with +.

email.description: The email the traveller booked with.

mobile.description: The mobile on the booking: with the reference instead of the email, or alone without the reference.

reference.description: The Vuelo booking reference, VU-... Leave out if the traveller does not have it, and pass the mobile alone.

name: find_my_booking
title: Send the traveller their booking page
